lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgAg₂ crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing six atoms—two Mg and four Ag—distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Ag and Mg centers in close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors each: Ag has 8 Ag and 4 Mg neighbors, while Mg has 12 Ag neighbors, with neighbor distances near 2.89–3.18 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Ag-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between Ag- and Mg-centered polyhedra.
